grass.%20Its%20loud%20bursts%20of%20song%20mean%20you'll%20usually%20hear%20it%20before%20you%20see%20it.%20But%20if%20you're%20determined%20to%20spot%20one,%20look%20for%20a%20dark,%20rather%20stocky%20warbler%20with%20short%20wings%20and%20a%20full,%20rounded%20tail,%20diving%20for%20cover.%5Cn%5CnThis%20Schedule%201%20species%20is%20one%20of%20the%20UK's%20most%20recent%20new%20residents,%20first%20breeding%20in%20Kent%20in%201972.&q;,&q;viewGuidelines&q;:&q;Cetti's%20Warblers%20like%20damp%20areas%20close%20to%20wetland.%20Look%20for%20them%20at%20RSPB%20reserves%20at%20Radipole%20Lake%20and%20Lodmoor,%20Dorset;%20Exminster%20Marshes,%20Devon;%20Marazion%20Marsh,%20Cornwall%20and%20Strumpshaw%20Fen,%20Norfolk.%20&q;,&q;images&q;:%5B%7B&q;url&q;:&q;https://base-prod.rspb-prod.magnolia-platform.com/dam/jcr:265c266a-fb56-493e-a4d8-24725d98cd0d/1589986492_Species_Cettis%20Warbler_on%20log%20with%20blurred%20background.jpg&q;,&q;metadata&q;:%7B&q;mimeType&q;:&q;image/jpeg&q;,&q;fileSize&q;:691851,&q;height&q;:1662,&q;width&q;:2491,&q;title&q;:&q;Cetti's%20Warbler%20on%20a%20tree%20stump%20with%20mealworms%20&q;,&q;caption&q;:&q;Cetti's%20Warbler&q;,&q;altText&q;:&q;Cetti's%20Warbler%20on%20a%20tree%20stump%20with%20mealworms%20&q;,&q;rights&q;:null,&q;publisher&q;:&q;Shutterstock&q;,&q;source&q;:null,&q;format&q;:&q;image/jpeg&q;,&q;subject&q;:%5B%5D,&q;modified&q;:&q;2025-08-19T09:09:34.827+00:00&q;%7D,&q;focalPoint&q;:%7B&q;focalLeft&q;:54.3859649122807,&q;focalTop&q;:53.28947368421053,&q;focalUrls&q;:%7B&q;landscape21to9&q;:&q;https://base-prod.rspb-prod.magnolia-platform.com/.imaging/focalpoint/landscape21to9/_WIDTH_x_HEIGHT_/dam/jcr:265c266a-fb56-493e-a4d8-24725d98cd0d/1589986492_Species_Cettis%20Warbler_on%20log%20with%20blurred%20background.jpg&q;,&q;landscape1to1&q;:&q;https://base-prod.rspb-prod.magnolia-platform.com/.imaging/focalpoint/landscape1to1/_WIDTH_x_HEIGHT_/dam/jcr:265c266a-fb56-493e-a4d8-24725d98cd0d/1589986492_Species_Cettis%20Warbler_on%20log%20
